findings.summary: The new `__next__` override on `_NamedTextIOWrapper` raises `EOFError` instead of `StopIteration`, so any command iterating over stdin (`for line in sys.stdin`, `click.File('-')`, `get_text_stream('stdin')`) crashes when input runs out instead of ending the loop.

Switching the prompt helpers from `readline()` to `next()` makes prompts abort on exhausted input instead of returning '' or using their default, a breaking change for existing tests that ships in a patch release (8.2.1).
`test_prompts_eof` only asserts `exit_code == 1`, so unrelated failures would also pass; it should check for `Aborted!` output or SystemExit, and it doesn't cover the hidden-input path.
